judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the mandate, successfully secured the cash refund and compensation, and politely rejected the travel voucher.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Thank you for calling IndiGo. For new bookings press 1. For an existing booking, cancellations or refunds press 2. For baggage press 3.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For refunds and cancellations press 1. To change your flight press 2. To speak to an agent press 0.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for your patience. Your call will be answered shortly.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to IndiGo, my name is Aisha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Aisha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Asha Rao, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Kilo Seven Mike Two Quebec X-ray, flight 6E2135.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for the details, Asha Rao. I can confirm your booking reference K7M2QX for flight 6E2135. May I know your reason for calling?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. My passenger's flight was cancelled with only 10 hours' notice due to operational reasons. Under DGCA paragraph 3.3, she is entitled to a full refund of 6,800 INR to her original payment method, and under paragraph 3. 3.3, she is also owed cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR. Could you please arrange both for her?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but my passenger cannot accept a travel voucher. She is entitled to a full cash refund of 6,800 INR to her original card, plus the DGCA cancellation compensation of 6,100 INR, under paragraph 3.3 and 3.3.3. Could you please process both?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand, Asha Rao. I'll process a full refund to the original payment method and the DGCA cancellation compensation as requested. Your reference number is X F U U 7 K.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is X-ray Foxtrot Uniform Uniform Seven Kilo. Could you please confirm that's correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Yes, the reference number is X-ray Foxtrot Uniform Uniform Seven Kilo. Your refund and compensation will be processed within 7 days. Have a great day!
